0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-7, 11th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central) visit the Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest) for Indiana's 11th game of the season, with the Pacers 0-5 at home, 3-2 on the road, and coming off a loss. Dallas enters on a two-game winning streak and is 4-2 at home and 2-2 on the road, while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), Morez Johnson Jr. (leg) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and the Pacers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 121-105 in Indianapolis on October 23, following an 0-2 result against Dallas in 2025-26.
